payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses a 1D DP array dp where dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2] (mod 1e9+7), and accumulates sum to count zebroid subsequences. Recurrence based only on previous two states.
payload.rationale: The DP state is one-dimensional, tracking number of ways for each length with a simple recurrence. No 2D, memoization, or other DP variant; it's a classic 1D DP with O(n) time.
